all_images.alt: Habit Outdoors Gift Card

body_text:
Description

Redeeming A Habit Outdoors E-Gift Card

Simple steps to redeem a Habit Outdoors E-Gift Card:

  1. Shop at habitoutdoors.com and select items you wish to purchase.
  2. When you’re ready to checkout, click on the shopping cart in the main menu.
  3. Proceed through the checkout.
  4. Enter your E-Gift card number on the shopping cart page or the payment page.
  5. If you have more than one E-Gift card, you may enter each code.

Rules and Regulations for Habit Outdoors E-Gift Cards:

  • E-Gift Cards must be redeemed through habitoutdoors.com.
  • You cannot purchase an E-Gift card with another E-Gift Card.
  • If the amount of your E-Gift card(s) does NOT cover the total order amount, you will need to pay for the remainder of the purchase with a valid credit card.
  • If the amount of your E-Gift card(s) is for MORE than the total order amount, the balance amount will be stored for your next purchase.
  • Habit Outdoors E-Gift Cards are non-refundable and are not redeemable for cash.
  • If you have any additional questions, please contact our Customer Service Department through our contact us page or at 866-370-0052.
  • No shipping or sales tax is charged when buying an E-Gift card

Redeeming A Habit Outdoors E-Gift Card

Simple steps to redeem a Habit Outdoors E-Gift Card:

  1. Shop at habitoutdoors.com and select items you wish to purchase.
  2. When you’re ready to checkout, click on the shopping cart in the main menu.
  3. Proceed through the checkout.
  4. Enter your E-Gift card number on the shopping cart page or the payment page.
  5. If you have more than one E-Gift card, you may enter each code.

Rules and Regulations for Habit Outdoors E-Gift Cards:

  • E-Gift Cards must be redeemed through habitoutdoors.com.
  • You cannot purchase an E-Gift card with another E-Gift Card.
  • If the amount of your E-Gift card(s) does NOT cover the total order amount, you will need to pay for the remainder of the purchase with a valid credit card.
  • If the amount of your E-Gift card(s) is for MORE than the total order amount, the balance amount will be stored for your next purchase.
  • Habit Outdoors E-Gift Cards are non-refundable and are not redeemable for cash.
  • If you have any additional questions, please contact our Customer Service Department through our contact us page or at 866-370-0052.
  • No shipping or sales tax is charged when buying an E-Gift card
